notes.title: Thank you for your patience. Ver.0.4 begins a new chapter.
notes.content: [h3][b]To All the Players Who Waited:[/b][/h3][p][/p][quote][p]Thank you for your continued support and patience over this period.[/p][p]Since the last update, we’ve poured an enormous amount of effort into crafting a more complete and deeper version of the game.[/p][p][b]Ver.0.4[/b] marks a major milestone in our development journey.[/p][p]This isn’t just another version update — it’s an expansion of the game’s world and a renewed promise to you, our players.[/p][/quote][p][/p][h3][b]Major Update Highlights[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]🧬 [b]New Content[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]6 New Element Types[/b]: 3 weapon elements and 3 skill elements are now introduced. These elements can interact with each other to create [b]chain reactions[/b], resulting in [b]powerful area-based explosions[/b] and significantly enriching your build strategies.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164857/ef5b1b2618b606a2a4b506437cb0a5eba5e81061.png"][/img][/p][p][b]New Tier 3 Boss[/b]: A deadly new challenge awaits. You'll need sharp reflexes and smart builds to survive.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164857/3a34726dd2b5f0badfec12a44b34c418a36668e6.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Over 300 New Synergy Items[/b]: A massive expansion of the item ecosystem, with gear designed around [b]six core categories[/b] — Skills, Weapons, Ammo, Energy, Defense, and Mobility — providing players with a wide variety of build options each run.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164857/1d8998bc314d1b3c8ba2fbc6ac5a1dad853c69e0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]⚙️ [b]System Overhaul[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Reworked Synergy System：[/p][p]The core synergy system has been completely overhauled. Attributes are now divided into six detailed categories: [b]Skills, Weapons, Ammo, Energy, Defense, and Movement[/b], with over [b]320 unique upgrade items[/b] available. You'll be making more strategic choices with limited room rewards.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164857/e815b8bb0a871fa213505eb3ad47cbfbb9dca0a4.png"][/img][/p][p]Skill System Redesign:[/p][p]Skills no longer upgrade gradually. Instead, each skill now comes with [b]inherent characteristics[/b], and you can further enhance a specific direction for [b]maximum benefit[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164857/f7dd11276df8c25fef04d1b3f0f55357f30625e5.png"][/img][/p][p]Recoil and Control Adjustments： [/p][p]Automatic weapons now have [b]significantly reduced recoil[/b], making for smoother control and lowering frustration. Special weapons like sniper rifles and shotguns have slightly adjusted recoil. We've also tweaked [b]character movement friction[/b] to improve stopping precision and dodging responsiveness.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164857/cff4faa775cb636ffa65e23f927d2afcaca80d95.png"][/img][/p][p]Level Design Overhaul:[/p][p]We’ve expanded level design with more space for movement and added [b]interactive environmental traps[/b] — such as anchors, slow zones, and water currents — to deepen spatial strategy during combat.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]📈[b]Difficulty Curve Adjustments：[/b][/p][list][*][p]The game now features [b]3 layers[/b], with an increasing number of rooms and difficulty per layer. Early-game difficulty has been eased to help players better engage with build progression.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]🧰[b]Optimization & Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved performance[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed known bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Backpack UI rework[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced controller input support[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple QoL (Quality-of-Life) improvements[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Demo Version / Trial Experience[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]In this demo update, some content will remain locked. Due to the [b]large number of synergy items[/b], their balance and scaling still require further refinement.[/p][p]Currently, [b]three weapons are available[/b] for testing. Each has distinct base attributes and handling. Our focus is to polish the experience around these three — including skill synergy and item builds — before unlocking the rest in the [b]Early Access (EA)[/b] version.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Future Plans[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Continue refining current synergy systems and difficulty balance[/p][/*][*][p]Expand [b]narrative content[/b]: Version 0.5 or 0.6 will introduce [b]discrete NPC interactions[/b] and [b]trigger-based events[/b][/p][/*][*][p]The narrative framework is in place, but the event system is still under development[/p][/*][*][p]Add more skills and build combinations to lay a solid foundation for EA[/p][/*][/list][p]The [b]full narrative experience[/b] will be released with [b]Version 1.0[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 0.3.1 Major Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, submarines:

Version 0.3 has finally been updated. This version adds a lot of props, weapons, second levels and bosses, etc.

Major changes:

Each floor's reward room has added a mutual exclusion system. When choosing a different room, the other connected room will be consumed (skills and weapons are mutually exclusive, upgrades and stores are mutually exclusive)

Rooms 1-13 no longer force the multiple growth of the gold room to be interrupted, and the store will be forced to refresh in room 14. (So if you want to choose to upgrade, you need to choose before the 14th)

The core room can always match three skill core props according to the equipped skills. Choose one.

The weapon component changes from a random prop to three choices, and matches according to the growth of the secondary attribute selected by the player.

Now you can choose to buy weapons, skills, skill cores, and weapon core props in the store room.

The effect of re-roll on the prop price is cancelled

Added 2 new skills, Lightning Ball, Hydraulic Blast.

Weapon component modules increased to 40

Modified the first-stage Boss Lunena

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164857/2eb265a968e5acdc7cc5f11acd529414ef78321e.png[/img]

Added the second-stage Boss GENINI

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164857/e0b4a0123c03ac1d599f35701f427222832f2423.png[/img]

Reduce the health and difficulty of all monsters in the first level

Added a three-choice secondary attribute growth after completing the gold coin room

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164857/bf3ecc2c276b65123d34904d03be692a5cb92227.png[/img]

There are more contents waiting for you to discover.

I wish you all a happy game.

notes.title: We finally arrived on steam!!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we have been developing for a year. The SeaQuest Dungeon is finally coming to everyone.


 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164857/fea61cdeecdbc90ddfe13a5cf9bf22a179361837.png[/img][h3]who we are:[/h3]

  We are two developers who have been in the gaming industry for many years. This is the first time we are responsible for developing a new project ourselves, and we are very excited and happy about it. I also hope that this project can bring you a reservation experience.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164857/388d426674e1df02cde681183aadf93fc3c59491.png[/img][h3]What is this game about?[/h3]

  SeaQuest Dungeon is a fast-paced twin-stick shooting game with pixel style.
It has a unique shooting operation experience, tight combat rhythm, and a wide variety of skill construction.Through weapons and skills, choose and match different types of props to achieve a powerful build.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164857/91ab119966de12309d9066194bf22255cf99d962.png[/img]
[h3]What's the plan?：[/h3]

 [b] The demo version will probably be released in [u]September[/u].[/b] The current status of the demo version is to test the core gameplay loop and the placement selection system for skill building. With fewer developers, we need a lot of feedback. Therefore, the art resources of the demo version are not complete.



https://store.steampowered.com/app/3157890/SeaQuestDungeon/

If you become interested in SeaQuest Dungeon, please don't forget to add it to your wishlist on Steam.
Feel free to contact us anytime with feedback. :)

Email: team.alchemist.game@gmail.com
